findings.title: The remembered diagnosis leaves room for complete family regathering
findings.claim: The repeated diagnosis of an affair made attractive by the brothers' own selves now stands beside beautiful restraint and the hope that all will be brought together; later confession and reunion clarify that the diagnosis can be confirmed without becoming a sentence of permanent estrangement.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers سَوَّلَتْ, أَنفُسُكُمْ, صَبْرٌ, جَمِيلٌ, and جَمِيعًا return through the supplied 12:18, 20:96, 15:85, 12:90, 12:91, 12:99, and 12:100 evidence. The earlier self-embellishment scene supplies memory, the beautiful-patience parallels supply a restrained response, and the later reunion supplies a changed horizon for the totality of the hoped return.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive patience here as morally discerning restraint that keeps a whole-family return imaginable, while the father's suspicion remains a diagnosis of an act rather than a final verdict on the people.
findings.containment: The ordinary accusation, patience, hope, and divine-attribute reading remains intact. The wider regathering image is a qualified contextual resonance; it does not activate every available branch under these roots, turn the hope into a human prediction, or erase the brothers' agency and responsibility.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run publication supplies the complete five-branch finding, while the corroborative reader-walk supports are legacy-unbound; the exact contextual connections are retained as evidence without being treated as a ranking signal.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin kendi iç yönelişi, bir işi kendi gözüne çekici ve uygun gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: سَوَّلَتْ carries the act of making an affair appear attractive to the person who is to receive it.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact earlier scene in 12:18 and the parallel self-soliciting account in 20:96 return the same inward inducement to the focus; the later confession in 12:91 confirms the diagnosis while changing its consequence.
branch_activations.activation: The focus verb is not merely a report of deception: its self-directed facet meets the repeated earlier scene and the later confession, so Jacob's present reply reads as memory-informed discernment that still leaves restoration open.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The brothers' account is recognized as a self-made attractive explanation, yet the recognition does not close the future of the family.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not activate the external-tempter facet, generalize the verb to every kind of deception, or claim that 12:91 removes responsibility.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iç düşünce, niyet ve ayırt etme gücü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَنفُسُكُمْ carries the brothers' inward selves as the grammatical and moral agents of the embellishment.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 12:18 recurrence and 20:96 parallel both make inward self-direction the relevant context for the focus accusation.
branch_activations.activation: The plural possessed selves meet the self-directed embellishment verb, turning the report into an account of inner agency rather than an unexplained external event.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Jacob's diagnosis reaches the brothers' inwardly held motive and judgment, which is why later restoration can coexist with confirmed wrongdoing.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the inward-thought facet, not a claim that the whole person, bodily life, or every hidden intention is disclosed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
branch_activations.carrier: صَبْرٌ names restraint that holds a person steady against the impulse to break under loss or complaint.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier 12:18 scene and the supplied beautiful-forbearance connection at 15:85 return the same response under unresolved injury.
branch_activations.activation: The consecutive link from the diagnosis into صَبْرٌ lets the remembered accusation meet an established form of self-restraint, so the response carries both pain and deliberate steadiness.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Beautiful patience is active containment of grief and reaction while the possibility of a different outcome remains open.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not erase grief, require silence, or turn patience into forced external restraint.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişide, bedende veya davranışta güzellik ve çirkinliğin karşıtı olma niteliğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: جَمِيلٌ gives the restraint a quality of fitting and graceful conduct rather than visual beauty.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact earlier pairing in 12:18 and the supplied 15:85 parallel place the same beautiful-patience expression in a future-facing response to harm.
branch_activations.activation: The adjective qualifies the patience already named, allowing the remembered diagnosis and the restrained response to meet as a graceful way of carrying injury.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The father's restraint has an ethical form: it protects the possibility of repair without answering the accusation with retaliation.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the conduct facet and does not claim that the brothers' act becomes beautiful or that forgiveness has already occurred.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ayrı parçalar birbirine yaklaştırılır ve dağınıklık sona erdirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: جَمِيعًا carries the state of the absent persons being brought together as a whole.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied later sequence begins the gathering in 12:90 and identifies the secure arrival and family restoration in 12:99-100 as the wider return through which the totality marker becomes materially legible.
branch_activations.activation: The focus totality marker meets later supplied family restoration, so all is heard not only as an undifferentiated quantity but as dispersed members brought back into one household scene.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The hope reaches toward complete regathering while the ordinary promise that all absent persons may be brought remains fully recoverable.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a family-scale contextual resonance, not an eschatological or universal gathering claim, and it does not make the later outcome a human prediction.

findings.title: The remembered diagnosis remains open to search
findings.claim: The repeated self-justifying pattern changes the shape of patience: because the father hopes that all may be brought, the later movement toward complaint and search remains possible within the restraint named here.
findings.mechanism: سَوَّلَتْ supplies the focus carrier, 12:18 supplies the remembered diagnostic trigger, and the supplied 12:84-12:88 context sequence supplies the changed horizon of grief, Godward complaint, and searching. The contact makes the present patience a non-final posture rather than a settled surrender to absence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how patience can preserve movement toward the missing rather than simply endure their absence, while the focus ayah still says only what it says about the present response.
findings.containment: The action-bearing development is a qualified wide-context inference from the legacy-unbound reader walk. It does not insert search verbs into 12:83, make active search the only form of patience, or displace the ordinary diagnosis and hope.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and 12:18 connection are supplied, but the changed action is carried by a legacy-unbound wide-context walk rather than a citable independent publication.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin kendi iç yönelişi, bir işi kendi gözüne çekici ve uygun gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: سَوَّلَتْ carries the earlier pattern of an inner self making a course of action appear attractive.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wide-context walk names the exact return to 12:18 and the subsequent 12:84-12:88 movement from grief and complaint into searching for the absent family members.
branch_activations.activation: The old diagnosis meets the later action sequence through the same focus verb, changing the reader's horizon from merely recognizing a false account to keeping the absent persons traceable.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Patience in the focus can be heard as an open, memory-informed stance that leaves room for continued seeking and eventual disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not make the later search a grammatical component of this verse, and the legacy-unbound source does not establish that every instance of patience carries this action.

findings.title: Hope rests under knowledge rather than circumstance
findings.claim: The final appeal to the Knowing, paired with wise governance, makes the hoped-for reunion intelligible as a God-directed expectation whose path exceeds the father's available evidence.
findings.mechanism: ٱلْعَلِيمُ carries the focus branch of knowing and grasping reality; the supplied 12:100 restoration connection returns through the final divine attributes and the realized family reunion. Their contact changes the hope from a forecast based on circumstances into an expectation bounded by divine knowledge and ordering.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why the father's hope remains disciplined: it is neither a claim to know the route nor a collapse into uncertainty, but a trust placed under the one who knows the hidden course.
findings.containment: The finding is qualified by the branch's lexicon status and the legacy-unbound walk that names the knowledge-and-wisdom relation. It does not activate the other available علم branches or turn the father's hope into immediate certainty from his own standpoint.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is supplied and the 12:100 connection is explicit, but the supporting reader walk is legacy-unbound and the paired حكيم claim is not independently branch-anchored in this candidate.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلْعَلِيمُ carries comprehensive knowing and grasp of what is true, placed at the close of the father's hope.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 12:100 connection joins the later family restoration to the closing divine attributes and explicitly returns that outcome to the hope voiced in the focus.
branch_activations.activation: The final attribute meets the later disclosed outcome, so the hope is framed by knowledge that can hold hidden circumstances and by wise ordering beyond the speaker's evidence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The father's expectation is disciplined reliance on divine knowledge rather than prediction from the brothers' testimony or from visible circumstances.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the father knows the route in advance, and it does not independently activate the unanchored حكيم branch named in the reader summary.
